records.article: Kyiv strikes (2022–present)
records.text: 7 October 2026: Russian forces strike Kyiv. Suspected unexploded Russian Iskander missile crashes. Casualties within the city: 2 dead

records.article: Kyiv strikes (2022–present)
records.text: 18 October 2026: Russian forces strike Kyiv. One person killed in the Desnianskyi District, a metro station damaged. Cosmo Multimall shopping and entertainment center hit in the Solomianskyi District. Casualties within the city: 1 dead, 8 injured

records.article: Kyiv strikes (2022–present)
records.text: 13 November 2026: Russian drone strikes the 2nd floor of the National Institute of Traumatology and Orthopedics in Kyiv, at 3:00am, Shevchenkivskyi District. Casualties within the city: 3 injured

records.article: Kyiv strikes (2022–present)
records.text: 20 November 2026: Russian missile and drone attacks in 20-30 minutes intervals, targeting three bridges in Kyiv on the Dnieper, water utility facility, and power stations. Casualties within the city: 6 killed

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 4 October 2026: Russian forces struck the Pivnichnyi Bridge in Kyiv, injuring two people.

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 19 October 2026: Kyiv was attacked with ballistic missiles. No casualties were reported, but there was damage to metro stations on the left bank of the Dnipro River, railway tracks, and power infrastructure, according to Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko. According to journalists from The Kyiv Independent, unlike the previous night’s attack, a warning was sent to residents before the strike occurred, allowing them to seek shelter.

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 19 October 2026: The Ukrainian telecommunications company DataGroup reported the destruction of its data center in Kyiv, stating that repairs or resumption of operations at the site were impossible. The company announced that it would continue limited operations from backup infrastructure.

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 20 October 2026: The GigaCenter datacenter, operating services for the telecommunications, cloud services and cybersecurity for GIGAGROUP in Kyiv was destroyed following a Russian strike.

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 21 October 2026: A Russian attack hit a residential building in Sviatoshynskyi district of Kyiv, killing at least two people and wounded others.

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 22 October 2026: A Russian strike in Kyiv caused damage to monastery buildings, residential buildings, shops, cafes and other civilian infrastructure.

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 27 October 2026: Russia attacked Kyiv with 16 ballistic missiles and almost 280 drones, hitting the South Bridge.

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 7 November 2026: A Russian overnight strike in Kyiv killed one person, injured eight others, including a child, and damaged the Northern Bridge and energy infrastructure. 4 out of 36 ballistic missiles, which included North Korean munitions, were intercepted.

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 13 November 2026: A Russian strike in Kyiv damaged the National Institute of Traumatology and Orthopedics, injuring three patients.

records.article: Timeline of the Russo-Ukrainian war (1 September 2026 – present)
records.text: 20 November 2026: Russian strikes damaged three bridges in Kyiv, killing at least nine people.
